sources: https://midnrreservations.com/ (Harrisville State Park campsites via the booking site's /api/resourcelocation/resources and /api/resource/feeDetails for 2026-10-27, 2027-05-18, 2027-06-15 and 2027-09-21; audit/state_park_fees/gtc_probe.py, read 2026-10-22)

values.note: 2027 on the booking site (same on 2027-05-18, 06-15 and 09-21): 20/30-amp sites $37 (171 sites), 50-amp sites $42 (19). The DNR's 2026 table and the booking site for 2026-10-27: $35 (20/30 A) / $40 (50 A). A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to all state park campgrounds.

fees.source: https://midnrreservations.com/ feeDetails per fee schedule ($37 for the 20/30-amp sites, $42 for the 50-amp sites on 2027-05-18 / 2027-06-15 / 2027-09-21; $35 / $40 on 2026-10-27) + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/camping-and-lodging-rates-and-operating-dates (Harrisville campground: modern 50 AMP $40, 20/30 AMP $35) + https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/harrisville ('A Recreation Passport (park pass) is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds'), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/harrisville ('There is 20- and 30-amp or 20-, 30- and 50-amp service available') + midnrreservations.com site attributes (19 sites 'Electrical Service=20 Amps/30 Amps/50 Amps', 171 '20 Amps/30 Amps'; every site 'Electric and Water Hookups=Electric Only', 'Sewer Hookup=No'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 195 sites in the modern campground (the booking site lists 190 campsites besides 2 mini cabins), most within view of Lake Huron, shaded by cedars, pines and a few maples; paved campground roads. Equipment lists run to 'Trailer or RV up to 50''.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/harrisville ('Number of sites: 195'; amenities 'Pull-through sites available'; 'The campground roads are paved') + midnrreservations.com allowed equipment ('Trailer or RV up to 50''), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Toilet & shower building (closed mid-October to late April), a two-lane sanitation station with potable water, and a dishwashing station.

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/harrisville (amenities 'Modern campground', 'Toilet & shower building', 'Sanitation station'; 'The park's sanitation station is in the modern campground. There is potable water available and two lanes'; 'a sanitation station and a dishwashing station'; 'the modern toilet and shower building is not available mid-October through late April') + the DNR rates page ('Modern campgrounds include flush toilets, showers, a sanitation station'), read 2026-10-22

booking.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/harrisville ('Harrisville Modern Campground: For reservations call 800-447-2757 or reserve online', linking https://www.midnrreservations.com/), read 2026-10-22

summary: DNR park page + booking site: 195 sites, 20/30 A everywhere and 50 A at 19, electric only (no water/sewer at sites), equipment to 50 ft, pull-throughs, paved roads, shower building, sanitation station with potable water, reservable online or by phone; phone 989-724-5126 and michigan.gov link match. Fees 35-40 (2026 DNR table) -> 37-42 (2027 booking site; 2026 in the note), Recreation Passport in fees.note. Season Apr 15 - Oct 21 already manual. --AWH note kept unchanged.
